scope_issue_assessments.detail: Linked sources also cover postoperative adhesions/hernias, rectus-sheath hematoma, upper-abdominal mimics and other differential contexts. Their full conditional anatomy and report-field integration remain unreviewed; this draft is not an exhaustive closed list.

Sonographic wall layers, graded-compression response and Doppler flow require modality-appropriate evidence. Static generic geometry does not prove dynamic compressibility, hyperemia, enhancement or tissue viability.

No independent clinical approval of gyri/sulci, thalamic regional or nuclear boundaries, pallidal segments, capsule limbs, cerebellar lobules or peduncles. Regional entries do not close fine anatomy scope.
Brain Anatomy includes labelled axial and regional illustrations. Every embedded label and adjacent structure still needs source-image review; the inventory is not an exhaustive closed list.
Arterial and venous territories vary and overlap. Patient-specific flow, patency, variant branching and supply cannot be inferred from a normative parent mesh or static map.

Linked vascular reading includes infarction, watershed, lacunar, PRES and venous thrombosis contexts. Corresponding disease modules and all lesion-dependent adjacent structures require separate reconciliation.
